Alexander Miller, an 18‑year‑old student from California, has developed a novel quantum‑error mitigation technique to improve the reliability of quantum computations. His method, highlighted by *The Times of India*, demonstrates methods for reducing noise in quantum systems at the hardware and algorithmic levels. The development is considered a promising step toward practical, error‑resilient quantum devices.
